name: What methods do plumbers use for main drain cleaning?

mainEntity.name: What methods do plumbers use for main drain cleaning?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbers typically use a few methods for main drain cleaning. The most common is snaking or augering, which involves inserting a flexible cable with a cutting head into the drain to break apart or retrieve blockages. For more stubborn clogs or tree root intrusions, hydro jetting is often employed. This method uses high-pressure water streams to thoroughly clean the inside of pipes, removing grease, scale, and roots. A camera inspection may be performed first to identify the exact location and nature of the blockage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common methods include snaking/augering for blockages and hydro jetting for stubborn clogs like tree roots.
